title: LIVING AMONG WHAT WAS NOT DRIVEN OUT

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: On the south the land belonged to Ephraim, on the north to Manasseh. The territory of Manasseh reached the Mediterranean Sea and bordered Asher on the north and Issachar on the east. Within Issachar and Asher, Manasseh also had Beth Shan, Ibleam and the people of Dor, Endor, Taanach and Megiddo, together with their surrounding settlements (the third in the list is Naphoth) - Josh 17:10-11 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The account continues to detail Manasseh's holdings, including several important towns — Beth Shan, Megiddo, Taanach — that lay within the territory of neighbouring tribes. These were significant, strategic places. On paper, Manasseh's inheritance was substantial and well-positioned, reaching from the sea and touching several tribal borders.

Yet, as the next verses will reveal, having these towns listed as theirs and actually possessing them were two different things. The inheritance was granted by God; the entering-in required faith and effort. Manasseh had the deed to these towns, but the living reality still lay ahead of them, requiring trust and obedience.

This is often how the Christian life works. In Christ, God has granted us so much — victory over sin, peace with God, the fruit of the Spirit, a sure hope. These are truly ours by God's promise. And yet, day by day, we have to enter into them by faith, laying hold of what God has already given. There can be a gap between what is granted and what is experienced, and that gap is crossed by trusting and obeying God. The towns were Manasseh's; the question was whether they would go up and possess them. So it is with all God has promised us in Christ (2 Pet 1:3-4).

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- What has God granted you in Christ that you have not yet fully entered into?
- Is there a gap between what God promises and what you experience?
- How might faith and obedience help you lay hold of what is already yours?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You for all You have granted me in Christ. Help me not to leave Your promises unclaimed, but to enter into them by faith and obedience day by day. Amen.
